title: The river is back: the town on the weir's opening morning
about: Summer 20, 09:00, on the river's south bank: the weir opened overnight (place.weir 3). Today's full river, the Heron afloat by the dock, Finn waiting on the bank beside her until the evening (his opening lines when you talk to him); the HUD reads "The Weir is open!". The river's first-morning moment has played (see river-first-morning).
